caption: The drawing depicts a cluster of stylized flowers composed of small, rounded, mosaic-like segments. At the center left, there is a large red flower with darker outlines and a pale center. Surrounding it are additional flowers: a pink flower at the top right, two orange flowers (one at the bottom left and one at the upper right), and a star-shaped red flower with a pale center at the right. A prominent purple flower with a yellow middle occupies the lower center of the composition. Green leaves and stems, also depicted with a similar segmented effect, extend from the base of the arrangement. The background consists of a neutral, light brownish-tan color with a subtle, irregular pattern that matches the segmented style of the flowers and leaves. The drawing is bordered by a simple thin black line set within a white margin, with handwritten text and numbers in black ink along the bottom edge.
title: Hooked Rug
